title: Amelia found able to spell, read minds, see spirits and know other languages

tellings.quote: discovered that Amelia was in there and could spell and then that she could read her mind and then that she was seeing stuff that that Mora the mother couldn't see she could see spirits and ghosts and then she started saying that she knew other languages and she could identify hieroglyphics and knew Hebrew and Portuguese and Spanish

plain: A girl named Amelia, whose family had not known she could communicate, was found to be able to spell, and then, her mother Mora says, to read her mother's mind, see spirits and ghosts, read hieroglyphics, and know Hebrew, Portuguese and Spanish. The documentary maker Ky Dickens tells the story, which she covered in The Telepathy Tapes, her series about children said to be telepathic, passing on what Mora told her. If true, it would mean the girl had abilities no one can explain.
